fact: The Gabonese Agency for Space Studies and Observations (AGEOS) produced the first national land cover maps for 2010 and 2015 from SPOT and Sentinel-2 images, showing forest and savanna converted to cultivated land (27,915 ha) between the two dates.
title: Cartographie de l'occupation du sol du Gabon en 2015 - changements entre 2010 et 2015
publisher: Revue Française de Photogrammétrie et de Télédétection (AGEOS)
